c37fe4a175c08079.description: About the Role Prima International is seeking an experienced Operations Manager to lead operations at its frozen bakery manufacturing facility in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires a professional with over 10 years of experience to ensure safe, efficient, and cost-effective operations, consistently achieving production, quality, and delivery targets. Role Overview The Operations Manager will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of the frozen bakery manufacturing process. The role demands strong technical knowledge of industrial bakery manufacturing, frozen product handling, automated production lines, and continuous improvement methodologies to optimize operational performance and maintain high standards of product quality and food safety. Key Responsibilities Lead daily factory operations, coordinating production, maintenance, sanitation, and warehouse activities with Quality Assurance and Supply Chain. Develop and execute production plans based on sales forecasts, customer orders, capacity, and inventory. Oversee frozen bakery manufacturing processes including mixing, dough preparation, lamination, forming, proofing/baking, freezing, and packaging. Maintain process controls for dough temperature, fermentation, product weight, freezing conditions, and finished product consistency. Ensure appropriate frozen storage and handling practices to preserve product quality and cold-chain integrity. Optimize production line performance, labor utilization, material yield, and equipment availability while reducing waste, downtime, and changeover losses. Manage operating budgets and monitor controllable manufacturing costs. Collaborate with the Maintenance team to prioritize preventive maintenance and improve equipment reliability. Ensure compliance with HACCP, GMP, food safety, hygiene, allergen control, traceability, and occupational safety requirements. Support audits, investigations, and corrective actions related to operational performance, product quality, and food safety. Lead production trials, new product introductions, equipment commissioning, and capacity expansion projects. Recruit, coach, and develop supervisors and operational staff, establishing clear accountability and performance expectations. Track and report operational KPIs, including production output, OEE, waste, yield, labor productivity, and manufacturing cost. Drive continuous improvement initiatives using structured problem-solving and Lean manufacturing principles. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Engineering, Manufacturing Management, or a related discipline; equivalent substantial industry experience will be considered. At least 8 years of relevant manufacturing experience, including 3–5 years in a production or operations management role within an industrial bakery environment. Hands-on experience in frozen bakery manufacturing is essential, preferably covering croissants, laminated dough, pastries, and other frozen dough or bakery products. Proven experience managing automated bakery production lines and multi-shift manufacturing teams. Strong understanding of dough processing, lamination, freezing technology, packaging, and frozen product storage. Demonstrated success in improving productivity, reducing manufacturing costs and waste, and maintaining consistent product quality. Practical knowledge of HACCP, GMP, food safety management systems, and factory hygiene controls. Experience in production planning, budgeting, inventory control, and ERP or manufacturing management systems. Experience with Rademaker, Lawrence, or comparable industrial bakery production lines is an advantage. Experience in factory start-ups, production line commissioning, or operational expansion is preferred. Required Competencies Leadership and development of multicultural teams. Strong planning, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Effective coordination across departments. Commercial awareness and cost control. Commitment to food safety, product quality, and workplace safety. Ability to manage operational priorities and support shift or weekend requirements when necessary. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic manufacturing environment. The role requires active involvement in factory operations and collaboration with various teams to achieve production excellence.

c32ad6e5682097b1.description: About the Role * Renal Care Saudi Arabia is seeking a Triage Nurse to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Triage Nurse plays a crucial role in ensuring organized patient flow and identifying immediate patient needs. Key Responsibilities Welcome and identify patients upon arrival using approved identification procedures. Accurately measure and document vital signs including blood pressure, pulse, temperature, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, and weight, as per clinic protocol. Conduct brief screening questions regarding symptoms, recent illness, infection risks, and changes in clinical condition. Recognize abnormal observations or concerning symptoms and promptly alert the responsible Dialysis Nurse, Head Nurse, or physician according to escalation protocols. Direct patients to the appropriate clinical team to support an organized and safe pre-dialysis patient flow. Record screening results accurately and promptly in approved clinical systems, communicating any concerns during handoff. Escalate emergencies immediately and provide assistance within training, competency, and authorized scope until the designated clinical team assumes care. Apply hand hygiene, standard precautions, appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), and infection prevention screening procedures. Identify patients requiring additional infection prevention precautions and notify the responsible clinical team. Maintain the readiness and cleanliness of the triage area and check screening equipment for serviceability. Participate in relevant safety training, competency assessments, incident reporting, and quality improvement activities. Perform duties dedicated exclusively to triage and screening; this position is not involved in routine dialysis bedside staffing assignments. This role does not involve independently initiating, managing, or discontinuing dialysis treatment, administering dialysis medications, or assuming ongoing dialysis patient care responsibilities. Qualifications and Requirements Education: Diploma in Nursing or a higher qualification from a recognized institution, subject to applicable Saudi regulatory and Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS) classification requirements. Experience: Entry-level candidates or those with up to one year of experience will be considered, contingent on licensure and competency assessment. Candidates with limited or no clinical experience must successfully complete the USRC Triage Nurse Training Program before independently performing assigned duties. Licensure: Valid SCFHS registration/classification and any other applicable practice authorization are required before commencing work. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with potential opportunities in Jeddah and Dhahran. The role operates within a clinical environment focused on patient triage and screening, separate from direct dialysis bedside care.

c36ce9426d625372.description: About Pasqal Pasqal specializes in the design and development of Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) and their associated software tools. The role is application-driven, involving the adaptation, integration, and deployment of existing approaches to address real-world partner and client use cases. The primary objective is to transform current methods into reliable client deliverables, with contributions to internal method improvement welcomed when they directly support project outcomes. Key Responsibilities Adapt and implement Pasqal’s existing quantum-enhanced graph ML algorithms to meet client datasets, constraints, and performance targets. Work with hardware and platform engineers to execute solutions on Pasqal QPUs, considering hardware and execution constraints, and reliability. c3b7d3d8e9159708.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة عبدالرحمن عثمان محمد العثمان وشريكه عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في سكاكا، الجوف. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات ومضخات التدفئة ومكيفات الهواء. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال صيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف لضمان دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال تركيب وصيانة أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. القدرة على تركيب معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية وتصليحها. فهم جيد لمعايير الجودة وسياسات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في سكاكا، الجوف، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل آمنة ومنظمة لجميع موظفيها. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة عبدالرحمن عثمان محمد العثمان وشريكه، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المخصصة لذلك.

c33d8bb4af4e9c1d.description: The Internal Auditor - Operations performs independent, risk-based operational audits across the organization in alignment with the Internal Audit Charter, methodology, and IIA Standards (IPPF). The role assesses governance, risk management, internal controls, and policy/regulatory compliance across end-to-end operational activities (hubs, logistics, fleet, gateways, customer service, cash/COD, and technology systems). Responsibilities Audit Planning & Preparation: Research operational areas, map process flows/risks, participate in pre-audit meetings, draft risk-and-control matrices, and establish sampling strategies. Shipment & Process Assurance: Audit full end-to-end logistics processes (booking, sorting, linehaul, delivery, POD, returns) and evaluate custody, scan sequence, timestamps, and seal controls. Cost, Productivity & Asset Reviews: Assess operational efficiency drivers (manpower, route/vehicle utilization, fleet maintenance, facility costs) and evaluate vendor/outsourced courier compliance against contracts and SLAs. Cash, COD & Revenue Controls: Test courier debriefs, COD collection/reconciliation, billing accuracy, and system inputs to prevent revenue leakage, loss, or unsupported write-offs. Data Analytics & Systems Assurance: Use Excel, Power BI, or analytical software to test 100% data populations, detect anomalies/overrides, and verify core operational system integrity. Safety, Security & Compliance: Review facility/fleet security, CCTV, safety protocols, regulatory permits, and incident escalations. Testing & Documentation: Execute testing, maintain evidence-backed working papers, and expand sample sizes when control failures are detected. Reporting & Recommendations: Draft clear audit observations, establish root causes, assign risk ratings, and propose practical corrective action plans. Action Follow-Up: Verify and test management closure evidence before signing off on resolved findings. Key Role Boundaries & Escalation Independence: Must remain objective and disclose any conflicts of interest or past operational roles immediately. Immediate Escalation: Suspected fraud, theft, deliberate control bypass, major shipment/cash loss, or severe safety/regulatory breaches must be escalated immediately. Formal Investigations: The auditor must not conduct formal fraud/misconduct investigations unless explicitly assigned under the formal investigation procedure. Decision Rights Category Scope May Decide Day-to-day audit execution, sample selection, evidence requests, routine walkthrough scheduling, and initial working paper drafts. May Recommend Scope expansion, control improvements, finding risk ratings, procedure changes, and fraud referrals. Requires Approval Audit scope/objective changes, final audit reports/ratings, external disclosures, and formal finding closures. Must Not Decide Operational policies, process ownership, control design/operation, risk acceptance, vendor selection, or disciplinary actions. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Audit Delivery (20%): Complete ≥95% of assigned audit tasks and milestones by scheduled target dates. Working-Paper Quality (15%): Achieve ≥95% compliance with audit documentation standards. Finding Evidence (15%): 100% of reported observations backed by traceable, verified evidence. Reporting Timeliness (15%): Draft observations submitted within agreed engagement deadlines. Critical Escalation (10%): Escalate 100% of validated critical risks/fraud indicators within 1 working day. Follow-Up Verification (10%): Complete ≥95% of assigned management action verifications on schedule. Data Analytics Usage (10%): Apply analytics/data testing in ≥80% of audits with available data. Professional Development (5%): Complete minimum 40 hours of relevant training annually. Bachelor’s degree in Internal Auditing, Accounting, Finance, Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or Engineering. Certifications: CIA (or in-progress), CFE, CRMA, CPA/ACCA, or ISO Lead Auditor preferred. Experience: Minimum 3+ years in internal audit, operational audit, risk, or compliance. Experience in logistics, transport, supply chain, or e-commerce is strongly preferred. Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in Excel; experience with Power BI, SQL, or audit management software is an advantage. Key Competencies: Professional scepticism, evidence-based judgment, root-cause analysis, concise report writing, and stakeholder communication.

c3e8c6089fac428d.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مجموعة سمايا عن حارس أمن للانضمام إلى فريقها في خميس مشيط، عسير. تهدف هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل إلى حماية الممتلكات والحفاظ على النظام من خلال المراقبة الدورية والتحكم في الدخول والخروج من أماكن العمل. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة عمليات الدخول إلى المنشأة ومغادرتها، وإصدار التصاريح اللازمة لذلك. التحقق من هوية الموردين والزوار وتسجيل بياناتهم، وإصدار تصاريح الدخول لهم. القيام بدوريات منتظمة في أماكن العمل، وتفقد البوابات والأبواب والنوافذ لضمان سلامتها. المرور بين الزوار والموظفين للحفاظ على النظام وحماية الممتلكات، ونشر اللوائح الداخلية للمنشأة. الاستجابة الفورية للإنذارات والتحقيق في الحوادث، والتواصل مع إدارات مكافحة الحرائق أو الإسعاف أو الشرطة عند الضرورة، وإبلاغ الإدارة بالوقائع. الالتزام التام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في المنشأة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الأمن أو ما يعادله. القدرة على مراقبة الممتلكات وحمايتها من السرقة والتخريب. القدرة على التعامل مع حالات الطوارئ بفعالية. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة خميس مشيط بمنطقة عسير. سيعمل حارس الأمن ضمن فريق مخصص لضمان أمن وسلامة المنشأة وموظفيها وزوارها. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

c35c562eb9c2f2a3.description: About Johnson & Johnson and the Cardiovascular Team At Johnson & Johnson, the focus is on healthcare innovation to address complex diseases and deliver advanced solutions. The company operates with a commitment to its employees, fostering an inclusive work environment that respects diversity and recognizes individual merit. This role is within the Cardiovascular team, which develops solutions for heart recovery, electrophysiology, and stroke, aiming to advance standards of care for patients with conditions such as heart failure and atrial fibrillation (AFib). Role Overview: Bids and Tender Senior Specialist, EP MEA The Bids and Tender Senior Specialist, EP MEA, supports the comprehensive bids and tender management process for the Electrophysiology business across the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region. This full-time position, based in Makkah, Jeddah, or Riyadh, focuses on ensuring submissions are timely, compliant, accurate, and competitive to support business growth and mitigate risks. The role involves managing tender execution in close collaboration with various internal functions, including Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Regulatory teams. The specialist contributes to effective tender evaluation, submission, award management, and post-award activities, while also supporting the Bids and Tendering Leader in enhancing tools, governance, reporting, and process discipline within EP MEA. The position requires 2-5 years of experience, strong stakeholder engagement, adherence to compliance standards, commercial acumen, and a continuous improvement mindset. Key Responsibilities Coordinate and manage the full bids and tender lifecycle across EP MEA, including pre-tender, quotation, submission, award, and post-award stages. Manage tender sourcing, application, documentation, and submission processes to ensure timely, high-quality, compliant, and competitive EP bids. Review tender requirements, evaluation criteria, technical specifications, commercial terms, and submission checklists for completeness and accuracy. Analyze tender outcomes through win/loss reviews, pricing simulations, competitor insights, and debriefs to inform future EP bid strategy. Maintain bids and tender databases, trackers, and central platforms to ensure data quality, visibility, and reliable reporting across EP MEA. Review legal, commercial, technical, and operational aspects of tender documents and escalate risks for timely resolution. Ensure tender activities comply with customer requirements, corporate policies, SOPs, approval matrices, and SOX control requirements. Collaborate proactively with EP Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, Regulatory, Legal, Compliance, and other functions to secure complete and value-added submissions. Act as a subject matter expert for EP bids and tender processes, tools, documentation standards, and compliance requirements. Prepare and share regular bids and tender performance metrics, dashboards, and reports with the Bids and Tendering Leader and relevant stakeholders. Performance Measures On-time, accurate, and compliant tender submissions. Quality of bid/no-bid recommendations, risk assessments, and leadership decision support. Tender performance outcomes, including win/loss insights, cycle time improvement, and value protection. Adherence to customer requirements, company policies, SOPs, approval matrices, and internal controls. Delivery of Bids and Tendering Excellence initiatives, tools, dashboards, and process improvements. Quality of stakeholder collaboration, knowledge sharing, and contribution to tender capability building. Internal and External Collaboration This role involves extensive collaboration with various internal and external stakeholders. Key interfaces include EP MEA Commercial Leaders, Country Sales and Marketing teams, Strategic Account Management, Finance, Supply Chain, Regulatory, HCC, Legal, Business Compliance, Distributors, EM/EMEA Pricing teams, Commercial Excellence, Customer Service, and regional EP portfolio stakeholders. The specialist will manage day-to-day interactions, keeping stakeholders informed of key bid and tender updates, risks, and required actions, and will facilitate pre- and post-tender meetings to align on requirements, strategy, timelines, outcomes, and lessons learned. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated strong stakeholder engagement skills. Rigorous attention to compliance standards. Proven commercial acumen. A continuous improvement mindset. Ability to provide guidance and training to commercial and non-commercial teams on bids and tender processes, documentation, systems, and governance requirements.

The System Dispatcher will collaborate with various internal and external stakeholders to maintain grid stability and reliability.

Build financial models to assess the cost of benefits, points liability, redemption rates, and program profitability. Develop commercial scenarios and sensitivity analyses to optimize the loyalty proposition. Identify opportunities for partner-funded benefits, commercial partnerships, and revenue generation. Define the economics and commercial principles for member acquisition, engagement, retention, and lifetime value. Collaborate with finance, product, technology, and experience teams to translate the commercial model into an executable loyalty proposition. Establish KPIs and dashboards to track program performance, customer value, and commercial return. Required Experience Strong experience in designing or optimizing loyalty programs, points-based ecosystems, and rewards structures. Excellent financial modeling and commercial analytics capabilities. Experience across retail, hospitality, travel, entertainment, tourism, sports, or large-scale customer experience ecosystems is highly desirable. Strong understanding of customer lifetime value, unit economics, points liability, and partner economics. Ability to translate complex commercial models into clear strategies and actionable recommendations. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic team focused on commercial strategy and loyalty program development.

This permanent role involves leading and overseeing the integration of all railway systems for a major railway project. Lead the coordination and integration of all railway systems, including signalling, communications, traction power, SCADA, OCC, rolling stock, platform systems, depot systems, and associated infrastructure. Manage system interfaces between rail systems, civil infrastructure, stations, depots, and operational environments. Establish and maintain system interface registers, ensuring all interfaces are identified, tracked, coordinated, and resolved. Coordinate multidisciplinary teams to ensure fully integrated and consistent system design outputs across all project stages. Support testing and commissioning activities, including FAT, SAT, SIT, integrated testing, trial operations, and operational readiness activities. c318a199fa570e97.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مركز تميزالانشاءات للاستشارات الهندسية عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم للمهندسين الكهربائيين في حل المشكلات الفنية. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد المخطط وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية للمشاريع الكهربائية. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين فيما يتعلق بأعمال تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية. اختبار الأنظمة الكهربائية بعد تركيبها لضمان التزامها بالمخطط الأولي والمواصفات المطلوبة. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية ضمن أعمال الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة، وتشخيص المكونات التالفة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والمواصفات الفنية. معرفة قوية بتركيب واختبار وصيانة المكونات الكهربائية المختلفة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في حل المشكلات والتشخيص الفني. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الهندسة الكهربائية في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بالجداول الزمنية. يتطلب الدور العمل الميداني في مواقع المشاريع المختلفة في الرياض، وتقديم الدعم الفني المستمر لضمان سير العمليات الكهربائية بكفاءة وأمان. معلومات إضافية هذا الدور بدوام كامل في الرياض، وتقدم شركة مركز تميزالانشاءات للاستشارات الهندسية فرصة للانضمام إلى فريقها المتخصص. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب في الوقت الحالي.

c340771dcd4cf987.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اسناد عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية جمع البيانات المتعلقة بالمنتجات، وبناء علاقات مع العملاء، وإتمام عمليات البيع، ومتابعة التحصيلات، وإعداد التقارير الدورية. يهدف الدور إلى دعم جهود المبيعات وتحقيق الأهداف المحددة للشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات التفصيلية المتعلقة بالمنتجات (السلع والخدمات) لضمان فهم شامل للعروض. بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، مع تضمين بيانات الاتصال والعناوين. التواصل مع العملاء المحتملين والحاليين من خلال الزيارات الميدانية أو المكالمات لتقديم عروض البيع. شرح مواصفات المنتجات وميزاتها التنافسية للعملاء بوضوح واحترافية. التحقق من الأسعار المعتمدة ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المخولة لإتمام عملية البيع. إتمام عمليات البيع، وتحرير الفواتير، وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة من العملاء. متابعة تحصيل ديون العملاء، وتسجيلها، وتوثيقها، وتوريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها، وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على جمع البيانات وتحليلها. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية قوية مع العملاء. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل مندوب المبيعات ضمن فريق ديناميكي لدعم أهداف المبيعات للشركة. عن شركة اسناد شركة اسناد هي شركة تسعى لتعزيز فريقها بمواهب جديدة في مجال المبيعات. نحن نلتزم بتقديم بيئة عمل داعمة تساهم في تطوير مهارات موظفينا وتحقيق أهدافهم المهنية. التقديم إذا كنت تمتلك المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة، ندعوك للتقديم على هذا الدور في الرياض.

c36c124efd6fddf3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مصنع جدة للدهانات والمعاجين عن مشغل آلة تعبئة منتجات كيميائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تشغيل ومراقبة آلات تعبئة المنتجات الكيميائية، مع ضمان الالتزام بإجراءات السلامة ومعايير التشغيل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل آلات تعبئة المنتجات الكيميائية ومراقبتها بشكل مستمر. تغذية الآلات بالمواد الخام والعبوات اللازمة لعملية التعبئة. تفقد آلات تعبئة المنتجات الكيميائية وتعقيمها وفقاً للتعليمات المحددة. تسجيل كميات المواد المنتجة وأصنافها، بالإضافة إلى كميات مواد التغليف المستهلكة. خدمة موقع العمل وتطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية والبيئة. المهام التشغيلية يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية ضمان سير عمليات التعبئة بكفاءة ودقة، بما في ذلك تغذية الآلات بالمنتج المطلوب تعبئته وتزويدها بالعبوات والمواد المناسبة لكل منتج، مع الالتزام التام بالتعليمات التشغيلية المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تشغيل ومراقبة آلات التعبئة. الالتزام بتطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة في بيئة العمل. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن بيئة عمل تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة في التعامل مع المنتجات الكيميائية. تقديم الطلبات للراغبين في التقدم لهذه الوظيفة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

c3e84bad11fb038a.description: About the Role Imagination is seeking a Senior Production Lead to join our team in Riyadh. Manage workflow and resourcing for projects within the role's remit, collaborating with Directors and resourcing personnel. Ensure the production team complies with Imagination standards, including profitable business practices, health and safety, commercial viability, documentation, and supplier best practices. Drive continuous process and delivery improvements across all delivery teams. Motivate, guide, and support the production team, contributing to their professional development. Develop practical working solutions for creative proposals, translating concepts into reality. Budget projects and programs, ensuring best value pricing, negotiating with suppliers, and selecting contractors. Oversee financial control of third-party spend and ensure Production Managers deliver projects within agreed timelines and budgets. Create and manage large-scale, complex budgets independently. Negotiate favorable costs and terms with suppliers and freelancers to deliver value. Collaborate with Project Directors/Managers for timely and precise financial reconciliation of production budgets upon project completion. Specify technical equipment and manufacturing in conjunction with Imagination specialist teams. c3f7e0fd069799cc.description: About the Role DXC Technology is seeking an experienced Storage & Backup Engineer – Associate Manager to lead storage and backup operations. Administer Veritas NetBackup environments, covering backup policies, monitoring, troubleshooting, restores, and reporting. Participate in CAB meetings, governance reviews, and service improvement initiatives. Manage incidents, requests, changes, and asset records through ServiceNow. Knowledge of SAN, NAS, storage replication, and data protection technologies. Experience with Disaster Recovery planning and testing. Experience working in enterprise data center environments. c3062ccd569b900a.description: About EDITION Hotels EDITION Hotels combine the vision of boutique hotelier Ian Schrager with the service delivery of a luxury hotel and the global reach of Marriott International. The brand focuses on providing a distinct hospitality experience, targeting consumers who value quality, originality, design, and service excellence without conventional limitations. Role Summary The Senior Sales Manager for The Jeddah EDITION is responsible for proactively soliciting and managing large group and catering opportunities with significant revenue potential. This full-time role, based in Jeddah, involves managing opportunities not handled by an Event Booking Center (EBC) and actively up-selling to maximize revenue. The position requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on achieving personal and team revenue goals while driving customer loyalty through service excellence. Key Responsibilities Target group and catering accounts, markets, or segments with an emphasis on proactive solicitation and account saturation. Partner with group and catering counterparts to effectively manage business opportunities. Respond to incoming group and catering opportunities for the property that are outside EBC parameters, or handle all opportunities if the property does not participate in an EBC. Identify, qualify, and solicit new group and catering business to achieve personal and property revenue goals, focusing on accounts with significant potential sales revenue. Handle complex business with significant revenue potential and customer expectations. Build and strengthen relationships with existing and new customers through sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, and trade shows. Develop relationships within the community to strengthen and expand the customer base for group and catering sales opportunities. Support the brand’s Service and Relationship Strategy by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience to drive loyalty. Execute brand’s Customer Service Standards and property’s Brand Standards, ensuring customer satisfaction before and during programs or events. Serve customers by understanding their needs and recommending appropriate features and services that meet and exceed expectations, building loyalty to the property and brand. Collaborate with off-property sales channels to ensure coordinated and complementary sales efforts. Manage and develop relationships with key internal and external stakeholders. Utilize sales resources, administrative/support staff, and intranet for information. Conduct site inspections and create contracts as required. Execute and support the operational aspects of booked business, including generating proposals, writing contracts, and customer correspondence. Candidate Profile We are seeking individuals who are outgoing and dedicated to providing service excellence. The ideal candidate will be inspired by a challenging work environment and committed to delivering exceptional guest experiences. This role is suited for professionals who thrive in a setting where service is delivered with genuine care. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in sales, preferably within the hospitality sector. Demonstrated ability to proactively solicit and manage group/catering opportunities. Strong negotiation and creative selling skills. Understanding of market conditions, competitor strengths, and economic trends. Proven track record of building and strengthening customer relationships. Commitment to delivering high standards of customer service. Application Join EDITION and become part of a global team within Marriott International, where you can contribute to a portfolio of distinguished brands.

The role requires 5-10 years of experience in civil or structural engineering. Key Responsibilities Monitor and inspect structural work to ensure compliance with design specifications and safety standards. Provide guidance on structural engineering principles and solutions for complex challenges. Coordinate with architects, contractors, and other stakeholders to achieve project objectives. Conduct quality checks to guarantee structural integrity and durability of steel structures. Manage project budgets, expenses, and timelines effectively. Ensure adherence to local and international regulations and codes for steel construction. Engage with clients to understand their requirements and provide technical insights. Knowledge of building codes and regulations related to steel structures. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c371c1c2f535b3d4.description: About the Role Fakeeh Care Group is seeking an Office Manager to oversee administrative operations for an assigned Executive, Chief, or Departmental Head. This full-time position is based in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah, and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. The role provides high-level administrative support, manages information requests, and supervises junior clerical staff. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to ensure smooth office operations and efficient task management by organizing and implementing administrative procedures. The Office Manager will be responsible for coordinating various activities and providing essential support to maintain an effective working environment. Key Responsibilities Organize and implement office operations and procedures, including correspondence management, filing systems, and workflows. Oversee and coordinate administrative activities to ensure the smooth functioning of the office environment. Prioritize office management tasks, addressing urgent matters promptly and efficiently. Provide comprehensive administrative support, including scheduling meetings, managing correspondence, handling visitors, and routing calls. Manage appointment calendars for designated team or department leaders, resolving scheduling conflicts and ensuring efficient time management. Prepare reports, presentations, and other documents, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery. Distribute meeting agendas and materials, take minutes during meetings as requested, and ensure follow-up actions are taken. Ensure timely finalization, approval, and distribution of meeting minutes to relevant stakeholders. Follow up on action items and resolutions from meetings, ensuring tasks are completed and issues are addressed. Contribute to team objectives by providing support for related tasks and projects, ensuring project timelines are met. Produce information by transcribing, formatting, inputting, editing, retrieving, copying, and transmitting text, data, and graphics. Maintain the office environment by ensuring its proper and safe condition and arranging for necessary repairs and supply orders. Create or modify documents using various applications (*, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and maintain relevant databases. Supervise and train junior clerical staff. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 2-5 years of experience in office administration or a related field is required. Demonstrated ability to provide high-level administrative support. Experience in managing information requests and supervising staff. Work Environment This is a full-time position within the Fakeeh Care Group, primarily located in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to operations in Jeddah. The role involves working closely with executive and departmental leadership. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c390caeb7dcf6686.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اجال للمختبرات عن فني كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة تنفيذ الأعمال الفنية والمخبرية المتعلقة باستقبال العينات وتجهيزها وتحليلها، بالإضافة إلى إجراء الاختبارات الكيميائية والمخبرية وفقًا للمعايير المعتمدة. يلتزم الفني الكيميائي بمتطلبات الجودة والسلامة المهنية وإجراءات التعامل الآمن مع العينات والمواد الكيميائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال وتجهيز وتحضير العينات لإجراء الفحوصات والتحاليل. تنفيذ الاختبارات والتحاليل الكيميائية والمخبرية وفق الطرق والإجراءات المعتمدة. تشغيل الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية والتأكد من جاهزيتها للاستخدام. تحضير المحاليل والكواشف والمواد اللازمة لإجراء الاختبارات. تسجيل وإدخال نتائج التحاليل في الأنظمة المعتمدة ومراجعة دقتها. تطبيق إجراءات ضبط ومراقبة الجودة على عمليات الفحص والتحليل. المحافظة على العينات وسلامة تخزينها والتعامل معها وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب المختبر والأجهزة والمعدات. الإبلاغ عن الأعطال والملاحظات الفنية المتعلقة بالأجهزة أو العينات. الالتزام بتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية عند التعامل مع المواد الكيميائية والعينات. توثيق الأعمال والنتائج وإعداد التقارير المخبرية حسب متطلبات العمل. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات المختبر والمعايير المعتمدة في الجودة والسلامة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تنفيذ الأعمال الفنية والمخبرية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات ومعايير الاختبارات الكيميائية والمخبرية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تشغيل الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية. القدرة على تسجيل وتوثيق نتائج التحاليل بدقة. الالتزام بمتطلبات الجودة والسلامة المهنية. مهارات التعامل الآمن مع العينات والمواد الكيميائية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ويقع في الرياض. سيعمل الفني الكيميائي ضمن فريق متخصص في مختبرات شركة اجال للمختبرات، مع التركيز على تطبيق أعلى معايير الجودة والسلامة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة اجال للمختبرات.

c3fda37b085ce5b0.description: About Daikin Saudi Daikin Saudi is a subsidiary of Daikin Middle East & Africa FZE, which is part of Daikin Industries Ltd. The company specializes in heating, cooling, ventilation, air purification, and refrigeration technology. Daikin designs, manufactures, and supplies a broad range of equipment and solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial applications across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). Daikin EMEA operates with over 12,000 employees across more than 59 consolidated subsidiaries and 12 major manufacturing facilities. Role Overview Daikin Saudi is seeking an HVAC Technician - Industrial Refrigeration for a full-time position in the Al Dar Al Baida District, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role involves the installation, operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of HVAC systems, with a focus on industrial refrigeration. The technician will work independently on-site, ensuring reliable system operation and high customer satisfaction while adhering to safety and service quality standards. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Perform installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair for Air-Cooled Chiller, Centrifugal Chiller, VRV & DX systems, Industrial Refrigeration (Ammonia Plant), and Commercial Refrigeration. Diagnose electrical, mechanical, and control faults, and implement corrective actions efficiently. Support commissioning, operation, and maintenance activities to ensure systems operate according to OEM standards. Identify root causes of system issues to minimize repeat breakdowns and optimize system performance through proper servicing, parameter checks, and minor adjustments. Escalate complex or recurring technical issues to supervisors as needed. Act as the on-site technical representative, maintaining professional communication with customers and explaining service activities, findings, and recommendations clearly. Complete service reports, checklists, and job documentation accurately and on time, recording system data, faults, and actions taken. Coordinate with supervisors, planners, and spare parts teams for smooth service execution. Adhere to all safety procedures, PPE requirements, and permit systems, ensuring safe handling of tools, equipment, and refrigerants. Stay updated on product knowledge, service practices, and new HVAC technologies, participating in trainings and applying learned skills in field activities. Qualifications and Experience Technical Diploma (ITI / Diploma in Mechanical, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, or equivalent). Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in HVAC service, specifically in installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of industrial refrigeration systems. Strong troubleshooting skills in electrical and refrigeration systems. Basic knowledge of HVAC controls and schematics reading. Ability to work independently at customer sites. Good communication and customer-handling skills. Familiarity with service reporting tools (manual or digital). Strong commitment to safety and quality standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring on-site service execution and coordination with supervisors and service teams to meet contractual SLAs and operational targets.

c3244a2d68afd8e5.description: About Asteri Beauty Asteri Beauty is a high-performance beauty brand based in Saudi Arabia, specializing in clean, long-wearing formulas with rich color payoff and skin-loving ingredients. The company is expanding across the GCC and internationally, focusing on building a world-class beauty footprint. The Role of Wholesale Account Manager Asteri Beauty is seeking a Wholesale Account Manager to lead and execute commercial and strategic wholesale operations. This full-time role is based in Riyadh and focuses on key retail accounts across the GCC region, including major partners such as Ulta Beauty and Travel Retail (Duty Free / Airport Outlets). The position is central to growing brand visibility, driving revenue across physical and omnichannel wholesale doors, building key-partner relationships, and implementing trade marketing and inventory strategies. Key Responsibilities Formulate and execute Joint Business Plans (JBPs) for major retail partners, establishing sales targets, promotional calendars, and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Drive sell-in and sell-through strategies across accounts, monitoring weekly and monthly sales data to identify growth opportunities. Lead negotiations for space and shelf-location, new product listings, end-cap placements, and travel-exclusive product offerings. Oversee the execution of in-store activations, promotional offers, Gift with Purchase (GWP) campaigns, and travel retail display activations. Serve as the main point of contact for retail buyers and category managers, managing range planning, assortment expansion, and promotional execution. Coordinate with internal teams including Marketing & Brand Communication, Supply Chain, Logistics & Operations, Finance & Commercial, and Retail Operations & Education/Training. Ensure smooth stock replenishment, logistics compliance, and adherence to retail distribution guidelines with retail partners. Internal and External Interactions The role requires close collaboration with various internal departments at Asteri Beauty, including Marketing & Brand Communication for campaign launches and retail activation plans, Supply Chain for demand forecasting and stock allocation, Finance for budget and margin analysis, and Retail Operations for brand standards and product education. Externally, the manager will build strategic relationships with retail buyers and category managers from key accounts like Ulta Beauty and Travel Retail, as well as with supply chain and merchandising teams of retail partners and duty-free distributors across the GCC region. Qualifications and Requirements 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to formulate and execute Joint Business Plans (JBPs). Experience in driving account performance and revenue growth. Proven negotiation skills and experience in assortment strategy. Background in trade marketing and promotions. Willingness to travel across the GCC (*, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman) and international travel retail hubs as required. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, requiring regular travel within the GCC region and to international travel retail hubs to manage key accounts and drive business growth.

c3c0ab3ac6842192.description: About DataVolt DataVolt is a global leader in sustainable and innovative data center solutions. The company provides infrastructure for businesses worldwide, focusing on security, reliability, scalability, and sustainability to support digital transformation. DataVolt operates in strategic locations including Riyadh, Dubai, Mumbai, Tashkent, Kuala Lumpur, and California, with a commitment to shaping a sustainable digital future through innovation. c3d67cbaefe80d5d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اتحاد الخدمات المساندة للمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التركيب والتشغيل والصيانة الوقائية للمعدات والتجهيزات الصناعية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في المجال الهندسي الميكانيكي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية لمشاريع الأعمال الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية بناءً على تعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذ هذه الإجراءات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. فهم جيد لبرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. معرفة ببرامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات الصناعية. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة الوظيفية بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق عمل متخصص يسعى لتحقيق أعلى معايير الجودة والكفاءة في المشاريع الهندسية. عن الشركة شركة اتحاد الخدمات المساندة للمقاولات هي شركة رائدة في مجال المقاولات، وتلتزم بتقديم حلول هندسية متكاملة ومبتكرة لعملائها. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الميكانيكيين المؤهلين والراغبين في الانضمام إلى فريقنا لتقديم طلباتهم.

c3e74bceece1e310.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة إنماء سكاكا للمقاولات عن فني ميكانيكي تمديدات صحية وتدفئة وغاز للانضمام إلى فريقها في القصيم، وتحديداً في مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. يركز هذا الدور على إعداد قوائم المواد والمعدات اللازمة لأعمال التمديدات، ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص أعطال المعدات الميكانيكية وصيانتها. هذه فرصة بدوام كامل تتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد قوائم مفصلة ببنود القطع والمواد والمعدات الضرورية لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة المركزية وشبكات الغاز. متابعة سير العمل وتنفيذ شبكات أنابيب التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة المركزية وشبكات الغاز لضمان الجودة والالتزام بالمواصفات. تشخيص الأعطال في المعدات الميكانيكية المختلفة ومتابعة عمليات الإصلاح لضمان عودتها للعمل بكفاءة. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات لضمان استمرارية عملها وتقليل الأعطال المفاجئة. الالتزام التام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع مراحل العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة والغاز أو صيانة المعدات الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد قوائم المواد والمعدات بدقة. مهارات جيدة في تشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية. بيئة العمل يعمل الفني ضمن فريق مؤسسة إنماء سكاكا للمقاولات في منطقة القصيم، مع التركيز على مواقع العمل في مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في المواقع المحددة لتنفيذ المهام ومتابعة المشاريع. عن مؤسسة إنماء سكاكا للمقاولات مؤسسة إنماء سكاكا للمقاولات هي شركة تعمل في مجال المقاولات، وتسعى لتقديم خدمات عالية الجودة في مشاريعها المختلفة. تلتزم المؤسسة بمعايير السلامة والجودة في جميع أعمالها. تقديم الطلبات نحن نشجع المرشحين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في مؤسسة إنماء سكاكا للمقاولات.

c3f0282402aa6134.description: The Fire Safety Engineer is responsible for delivering technical fire and life safety engineering activities across KAUST under the direction of the Fire Safety Engineering Lead. The Fire Safety Engineer also supports compliance with Saudi Civil Defense requirements, Saudi Building Code (SBC), National Fire Protection Association (NFPA), International Fire Code (IFC), and KAUST requirements by maintaining audit-ready evidence, verifying fire protection system performance, supporting Civil Defense-related documentation and inspections where applicable, and escalating significant fire and life safety risks. Responsibilities Conduct fire and life safety engineering reviews, assessments, inspections, and field verifications. Review fire safety requirements for new construction, renovations, research facilities, high-hazard areas, and fire protection systems. Ensure compliance with SBC, NFPA, IFC, KAUST requirements, and Saudi Civil Defense requirements. Support investigations of fire incidents, unwanted alarms, system failures, and impairments, including root cause analysis and corrective actions. Minimum 6 years of professional experience in fire protection engineering, fire systems engineering, fire prevention, or fire & life safety compliance. Experience with deficiency management, corrective actions, and closeout. Experience working in complex environments such as universities, research facilities, industrial facilities, healthcare, mixed-use communities, or large campuses.
